url.label: Flair URL
url.help: Base URL for the Flair server

agentId.label: Agent Allow-list (optional)
agentId.help: Optional. When set, ONLY this agent is served; serving any other agent refuses. Leave unset on a multi-agent gateway so each agent acts as itself; never set a fixed agentId on a gateway serving more than one agent.

keyPath.label: Private Key Path
keyPath.help: Explicit Ed25519 private key path. Valid only with a single allowed agent (agentId set); otherwise the plugin refuses to register. By default the per-agent key keys/<agentId>.key is resolved.

autoCapture.label: Auto-Capture
autoCapture.help: Automatically capture important information from conversations. Off by default; requires the host's allowConversationAccess permission. Not production-ready until slice 2.

autoRecall.label: Auto-Recall
autoRecall.help: Automatically inject relevant memories into context at session start

autoCaptureMaxPerSession.label: Auto-Capture Max Per Session
autoCaptureMaxPerSession.help: Cap on trigger-based auto-captures per session (default 3). For a long-lived persistent session, this is the cap for the session's whole lifetime, not per calendar day.
